findings: Luna API of surface-manager (service names from com.webos.surfacemanager.service): com.webos.surfacemanager: showSpinner {show,owner}: launch spinner (no owner) or infinite spinner (owner); showIndicator {action show|hide,owner}: mic icon; showQuickSettings/showInputPicker: launch systemUI overlays com.webos.app.quicksettings/quickinputpicker; setZoom {visible,value}: Screen Zoom on/off+percent; getZoomStatus; alertChoice: answers zoom pointer alert; setScreenVisible {name:primary,visible,reason}/getScreenVisible: blank/restore the UI output; changeMultiViewLayout/setMultiViewLayout {mode normal|pip|sxs,apps[]}: multi-view layout; setPinOverlayView {appId,overlayId}: keep overlay over app; closeByAppId; captureCompositorOutput {output,format BMP|JPG|PNG}: screenshot; clearRecentsList/closeLRUSurface/getRecentsAppList; getCurrentState (launcher|quick-menu|spinner|alertView|none); getForeground*/getFocusedWindowInfo/getWindowGroupInfo/getLastInputType/getOverlayPlayVideoState/getMultiViewLayoutAnimationState: state subscriptions only.

Other surface-manager luna services: com.webos.service.systemUIManager launch/closeByAppId/getForegroundAppInfo (opens systemUI apps listed in configd systemUIManager.appinfo); com.webos.service.sysuicompmgr launch/close (voiceagent, touchremote, mobileconnection) and changeSystemUIView {viewName,viewSource|appId} which persists to /var/preferences/starfish-luna-surface-manager/systemUiViews.json (absent now) and can replace notificationView with any QML; com.webos.coverUI open/close/getStatus; com.webos.surfacemanager.systemui/closeAllSystemUI {onlyCompositorOwns} (closes splash, spinner, keyboard, notifications, then overlays/floating/home/screensaver/voice); .home/getCurrentHomeUIState; .hcap get/setHcapOpacity; .screenSaver/restartUserActivityTimer; .input blockKeyInput/cancelBlockKeyInput/registerAllowedKey; com.webos.service.recent listRecents/removeRecent/removeAllRecents/requestScreenCapture; com.webos.keyfilter.magicnumber/notifyChannelToRegister (creates Quick Access YES/NO alert).

Replacement dependencies: tvpower waits for the compositor to ACK /power2/responsePreparePowerOff and responsePreparePowerOn, and for responsePowerOffLogoRequest (masterbrand off logo launched via screencover); a replacement compositor must answer these. On suspend/power-off it clears fullscreen, closes overlays/home/coverUI, deletes screen captures; on power on it waits 1s for graphics before ack.

Compositor output is 1920x1080 (configd compositorGeometry, eglfs fb0), so widthScale=1 and every compositor image comes from images/ (HD). images/4k (94 files) and images/qhd (26) are never selected. Unreferenced anywhere in QML/JS/JSON: global_tooltip_l/m/r, ic_multiview_screenshare_f/n, img_option_panel_l/r, img_pip_169_large_focused, screenshare_overlay_* (exit, modeswitching, movning, scale, soundswitching); 4k-only ic_multiview_hide/pip/sidebyside/size/move/fullscreen/close are also unreferenced (no screenshare overlay or option-panel QML exists in this slice).

Image map (images/): vol_bar_bg, vol_gage*, vol_up/dn, volume_mask = volume bar; ic_speaker/headphone/bluetooth/bluetoothsorround/wisa/wow_orchestra, volume_wowcast = source icons; volume_bt_up/dn(_f) = '+'/'-' exterior icons; volume_mute/volume_disabled = mute/disabled bubbles; ic_multiview_*(more, mute, speaker, soundswiching, close, mixing on/off, vol plus/minus) + img_option_panel2/3_l/r + img_option_panel_2screen/3screen = multi-view decoration option panel; img_pip_*_input_handle* = PiP drag handle; ic_multiview_standby = standby tile; ic_back/ic_home/ic_recent = gesture feedback; ic_external_mic = indicator; touch_lock = touch toast; Spinner_large.gif = spinners; splash_default_2k, qned99_splash_black (only if tv.model.toolType QNED99; this set is C4) = splash; magic_number_channel_icon = Quick Access channel alert.

Volume OSD on this set: soundOutput=external_arc (Denon eARC), volumeSyncable=false, volume 35 (live getter). Volume key = speaker icon plus '+'/'-' with the active one in a white circle for 1.5s, no number and no bar. Mute = persistent 96px mute bubble at right edge that hops up/down every 10s (keepMuteScenarios true for external_arc). volumeOSD=true, disableMuteAnimation unset, tvlinkOsdDisplay null.

Splash/spinner policy: per-app splash image from appinfo splashBackground (47 of 149 apps, incl. Netflix, YouTube, Prime, Plex, Moonlight, GeForce NOW, HDMI/LiveTV); no splash for Home app or apps with noSplashOnLaunch (airplay, settings, overlays, ACR apps). spinnerOnLaunch is set for most apps but the compositor only draws the spinner for overlay/popup/floating apps and channelsetting/channeledit/familycare/scheduler, only when no splash is shown.

Access policy: the foreground app's window properties _WEBOS_ACCESS_POLICY_* (WINDOW, RIBBON, FLOATING, TOPUI, OVERLAY, SETTINGS, INPUTS, POPUP, KEYBOARD, NUDGE, SCREENREMOTE, ALERTS, TOASTS, PINCODEPROMPTS, KEYS_*) decide whether those views may open; _WEBOS_WINDOW_TYPE_RESTRICTED (factory) closes/blocks nearly everything. A new fullscreen app closes keyboard, alerts, home, overlay, overlay group, screenremote, nudge (unless pinned overlay).

Unreachable or dead on this set: AirPlay floating toolbar (airplay is a card; Settings.local.toolbar missing), HCAP (hotel off), gesture feedback and touch-lock toast (no touch panel), TopUI (avatar app not in listApps), PartialViewPositioner/rolling-screen (supportScreenType none), FPS box (flag file absent), secondary fb1 window (single panel; surface-manager holds only /dev/dri/card0), debug overlays (debug.enable false), Base Launcher/Spinner/OverlayView/notification set (overridden).

Screen Zoom/adjustments: whole-UI shader (zoom 110-200%, default 150; grayscale; invert) toggled through com.lge.settingsservice option.screenMagnification/adjustments (all off now). Reachable by luna setZoom, zoom key, or Home long-press 2.5s (KeyFilters/systemUi.js handleHomeKeys, shows the long-press ring); configd keyFilters runs LumaGlass handleLumaHome first, so stock Home long-press may never be reached. Zoom UI uses ZoomView (minimap+key guide) and ZoomKeyGuide hint (3s).

Recents/app switcher are not drawn by the compositor: StarfishRecents keeps recents.db (com.webos.launcher.recentsitems, up to 5 backup items) plus a periodic screenshot (120s timer, via com.webos.service.capture) and serves them over com.webos.service.recent/listRecents to the Home app (com.webos.app.home, Flutter). Closing the last app relaunches the most recent app (recents), then lastInputApp, then profile.idleApp (home).

Existing LumaGlass footprint seen on the TV: QML2_IMPORT_PATH puts /var/lib/lumaglass/qml first (contains WebOSCompositor/lumaglass/*.qml+icons), /var/lib/lumaglass/compositor.qml (1448 lines, FullscreenContainer-like copy), systemui/QuickSettings registered in configd systemUIManager, keyfilter/lumaglass.js first in configd keyFilters. Compositor views in this slice otherwise run stock.
